subject.title: feat(release): preflight all extended-stable npm packages

question: Should validation-only extended-stable core npm preflight accept any exact repository commit SHA and pack every publishable plugin package inside the read-only preflight job?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but the acceptable release rehearsal scope and proof bar are release-manager policy decisions rather than code-review facts.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the new preflight shape once linked workflow-dispatch logs or a redacted terminal transcript prove plugin tarball artifacts and publish gates remain read-only.

options.title: Keep plugin proof separate
options.body: Leave all-plugin package proof in the existing Plugin NPM Release workflow and keep the core npm preflight narrower.

options.title: Limit SHA rehearsal
options.body: Allow plugin artifact preflight only for the selected workflow branch tip until release owners explicitly want arbitrary-SHA rehearsal.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the new preflight shape once linked workflow-dispatch logs or a redacted terminal transcript prove plugin tarball artifacts and publish gates remain read-only.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the touched release workflow and release-check path to this owner boundary.
